summary: Some JOSE and COSE algorithm identifiers leave details, such as the curve or hash, to be inferred from other information. This specification defines fully-specified identifiers that state every choice. It updates RFC 7518, RFC 8037 and RFC 9053, which define earlier algorithm identifiers.

eli5.summary: A recipe that says "bake a cake" leaves guessing to the cook. These names give the whole recipe, so everyone makes exactly the same thing.
